name: Jian Hao Lim
bio:
Jian Hao's fascination with motorsport began during his national service, where he worked on maintaining the electrical systems of military vehicles. This hands-on experience ignited a passion that led him to pursue a degree in Electrical Engineering at the National University of Singapore. After graduating, he joined a local racing team, honing his skills in data analysis and electronic systems optimization. His meticulous approach and ability to diagnose complex problems quickly earned him a reputation as a rising star.

He joined Crown Racing three years ago, drawn by their ambitious projects and commitment to innovation. Jian Hao thrives in high-pressure environments and is known for his relentless pursuit of performance gains. He believes that a deep understanding of the car's electronic systems is crucial for unlocking its full potential, and he constantly seeks new ways to improve its reliability and efficiency. Though sometimes perceived as demanding, he is respected for his expertise and dedication to the team's success. 

Jian Hao is known for his innovative approach to problem-solving and his ability to adapt to changing circumstances. He is always looking for new ways to improve the car's performance and is not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom. His demanding nature pushes his colleagues to achieve their best, making him a valuable asset to the team.
